description: This PHP class 'exec_cfield_mgr' manages custom fields related to test execution within the TestLink project. It includes methods for generating HTML inputs, retrieving linked custom fields for a project, and managing filter values for custom fields.

classes.name: exec_cfield_mgr
classes.description: A class managing custom fields for test execution in TestLink, extending cfield_mgr.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database reference and retrieves linked custom fields for a project.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML table rows for custom fields input, tailored to field types.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields linked to a specific project, excluding certain types.

methods.name: field_names
methods.description: Returns an array of custom field identifiers and associated metadata.

methods.name: get_set_values
methods.description: Retrieves user-set filter values for custom fields from request parameters.
